meta.title: Sidebar workspace categories
meta.description: Group the sidebar's workspaces into custom categories. Each category is one rounded box that holds its workspaces and their sessions; press and hold a workspace title to drag it into another category, and press and hold a category header to reorder it. Categories can be renamed, coloured, pinned to the top, folded, or deleted; workspaces you have not filed yet stay in an Unassigned box.
